aliasWitness.meaning: The coefficient-faithful p=853 mixer aliases even a unit-cube input; p=5167 is the first prime satisfying the worst-case wrap-free N=1 bound.

protocol.calibration: prepare the marked sign vector and measure output channel four before any interacting evolution
protocol.pass: the decoded centered output equals 2579 at p=5167 or larger, and every preregistered random vector in the N-box agrees with integer K^-1 multiplication
protocol.fail: any modular alias, canonical-pairing failure, or disagreement with the integer oracle

established: a sufficient exact no-alias dimension ladder for the bounded 24-channel rotor subspace and a concrete falsifier of the smaller coefficient-only truncation
boundary: No-wrap compilation is not continuum convergence. It controls basis-change aliasing only; energy-cutoff error, Trotter error, bulk-gap stability and chiral-edge scaling remain separate measurements.
